text: 86年人，无房丁克，有个感情稳定的老婆，工作不稳定，月收入8k，北漂了二十年，一事无成，家庭存款四五十万
en: Born in 1986, with no house and a DINK, a wife and a stable relationship, unstable work, a monthly income of 8k, having been a Beijing drifter for twenty years, achieved nothing, and family savings of four to five hundred thousand.

text: 你要说人生体会，无非是那几句鸡汤，但这两年是越来越认同鸡汤了，比如: 人生所有的苦难除了病痛以外都是你的价值观造成的，这句话讲的是真好，我这岁数没有房子，一个月挣几千块，有的人会觉得惨，惨不惨那就看自己怎么想了？
en: If you ask about life lessons, they are nothing but those few bits of chicken soup, but over the past two years I have come to agree with chicken soup more and more. For example: all the suffering in life, except for illness, is caused by your value system—that is really well said. At my age, with no house and earning a few thousand a month, some would think it miserable, but whether it is miserable or not depends on how you look at it?

text: 挣的不多，但花的也不多，够用了，衣食住行，都是拼多多闲鱼，从不在商场买衣服吃饭，自己做饭能花几个钱？
en: I do not earn much, but I do not spend much either; it is enough. For food, clothing, housing and transport, it is all Pinduoduo and Xianyu; I never buy clothes or eat at shopping malls, and cooking for myself—how much can that cost?

text: 社保每个月自己交，父母有退休工资有积蓄甚至可以给自己托底，工作忙的时候一天工作十四五个小时，一个月挣个一万五六，像这个月不忙休息了半个月就挣五六千，休息的时候看看书，听听英语，最近又买了个二手相机为明年的中东出行做准备。
en: I pay my own social insurance every month; my parents have pensions and savings and can even be a safety net for me. When work is busy I work fourteen or fifteen hours a day and earn fifteen or sixteen thousand a month; like this month, when it was not busy and I rested for half the month, I earned five or six thousand. When resting I read, listen to English, and recently bought a second-hand camera to prepare for next year's trip to the Middle East.

text: 目前来看，坚持没要孩子是我作出的最正确的决定，如果当初顶不住压力选择生了孩子，我的人生一定会是一个天翻地覆的变化，我不可能在早上8点多还躺在床上在知乎码字，也不可能整天想着去中东旅行，没事了还有闲工夫读读书，一定的必然的会被生活压弯了腰
en: For now, holding out and not having children is the most correct decision I have made. Had I not withstood the pressure and had chosen to have a child, my life would surely have changed beyond recognition. I could not still be lying in bed past eight in the morning tapping out words on Zhihu, could not be thinking all day about travelling to the Middle East, and in my free time have the leisure to read—I would surely and inevitably have been bent double by life.

text: 我高中时一个农村同学讲了句话，我记忆深刻，他说人活着图什么？
en: A classmate from the countryside in high school said something I remember deeply: he said, what is the point of being alive?

text: 不就图一个舒坦吗，我当时很不屑，人活着怎么就光为了舒坦，难道不应该有远大理想吗？
en: Is it not just for a bit of comfort? I was very dismissive at the time—how can being alive be only for comfort; should there not be lofty ideals?

text: 现在到了中登了，觉得同学十几岁时的那句话是多么的朴素和真实啊，人活着，怎么舒坦怎么活，吃饺子蘸尿各有所好，谁规定吃饺子必须得蘸着醋了？
en: Now that I have reached middle age, I feel how plain and true that classmate's words from his teens were. Being alive, live however feels comfortable. Dipping dumplings in sauce is a matter of personal taste—who ever said you must dip dumplings in vinegar?

text: 你就喜欢蘸香油吃，就喜欢蘸芥末吃，那就自己怎么舒坦怎么来啊，永远不要在意别人的看法，永远不要把评判权交出去，当然，你喜欢孩子，你觉得生孩子养孩子能让你快乐，那就使劲生
en: If you like dipping in sesame oil, or like dipping in mustard, then just do whatever is comfortable for you. Never mind others' opinions, never hand over the right to judge. Of course, if you like children and feel having and raising them makes you happy, then have them to your heart's content.

text: 多关注身边的事，和自己不相关的事少打听少评价，最最愚蠢的是被他人的情绪裹挟，比如，被宏大叙事裹挟，被男女对立裹挟，甭管他们怎么叙事怎么对立，你就当是个屁，离屁远一点，玩相机的人都知道，拍人像怎么好看？
en: Pay more attention to things around you, and inquire and comment less on things unrelated to yourself. The most foolish thing is to be swept along by others' emotions—for example, swept along by the grand narrative, swept along by gender antagonism. No matter how they narrate or oppose, just treat it like a fart and keep your distance from the fart. Anyone who plays with cameras knows: how do you make a portrait look good?

text: 得用大光圈，得背景虚化，画面里只有人物是清晰的，后面的背景全是模糊的，这拍出来才好看，张爱玲小团圆里写的一句话，我摘抄了下来：身边的事比世界大事要紧，因为画图远近大小的比例，窗台上的瓶花比窗外的群众场面大
en: You need a large aperture and background blur; in the frame only the person is sharp and everything behind is blurred—that is what makes it look good. I copied out a line from Ailing Zhang's Little Reunion: things close at hand matter more than world events, because in the proportions of near and far, large and small of a picture, the vase of flowers on the windowsill is bigger than the crowd scene outside the window.

text: 有人说了，你这意思不就是躺平吗？
en: Someone said, does your meaning not just amount to lying flat?

text: 还真不是，让我重新选择，我一定会当初好好读书，念个好大学，这样选择面就会大很多，但现在事已至此，你不得坦然面对现在的生活吗？
en: It really is not. If I could choose again, I would surely have studied hard back then and gone to a good university, so my range of choices would be much wider. But things having come to this, do you not have to accept your present life calmly?

text: 努力不一定改变命运，但不努力是一定改变不了的，我跑过两年的滴滴，深深的体会到了靠努力劳动是不会让你富裕的，只能是糊口，那就真不如慢下来，好好享受生活
en: Effort does not necessarily change your fate, but without effort it certainly will not. I drove for Didi for two years and deeply realised that hard labour will not make you rich, it only lets you scrape by—so you might as well slow down and properly enjoy life.

text: 有一点我承认，我们这种家庭抗风险能力太差，一场大病会一贫如洗，这我承认，可是，人这一生真的会得一场掏空你家底的大病吗？
en: One thing I admit: a family like ours has too little capacity to weather risk; a single serious illness could reduce us to utter poverty. I admit that. But will a person really get in their lifetime a serious illness that empties out the family coffers?

text: 概率极低吧，我们何必要为了一件发生概率很低并且很有可能是七八十岁才发生的事情而影响现在每天的生活呢
en: The probability is extremely low, so why should we let something with such a low probability of happening—and quite possibly only happening in our seventies or eighties—affect our daily life now?

text: 所以，健康在你的生活序列里永远是排第一位的，干净的饮食，良好的作息，正能量的情绪永远是第一位的
en: So health is always first in your life's order of priorities; clean eating, a good routine, and positive emotions are always first.

text: 分割线
en: 分割线

text: 既然是谈感悟，那就最后再叨逼叨一次，这两天读唐师曾的书（这哥们儿原来新华社记者，1991年跑到中东报道海湾战争，可谓是全中国为数不多的战地记者）也是百感交集，
en: Since this is about reflections, let me ramble on one last time. Reading Shizeng Tang's books these past two days (this fellow was formerly a Xinhua News Agency journalist, and in 1991 went to the Middle East to report on the Gulf War—truly one of the few war correspondents in all of China), I was also overcome with mixed feelings,

text: 一个人也好，公司也好，国家也好，你别臭牛逼，穷横，横之前好好掂量掂量自己到底行不行，就说萨达姆这哥们儿当初那么牛逼的一个人20出头去刺杀他们总理，
en: Whether a person, a company, or a country, do not act all high and mighty, do not be broke yet defiant—before being defiant, weigh up properly whether you are actually up to it. Take Saddam, this fellow, who was such a 'big shot' back then, going to assassinate their prime minister in his early twenties,

text: 最后当上总统把伊拉克治理的富的流油，可非要跟美国较劲，让人家把全国的军事设施炸个遍，这时候你该认怂就认怂啊，可还是不服气，
en: and finally became president and governed Iraq into being rich beyond measure, yet he had to pick a fight with America and let them bomb military facilities all over the country. At that point you should have backed down, but he still would not accept it,

text: 最后让人家在地窖里给活捉了，还给绞死，一代枭雄，落得这么个下场，那卡扎菲不也一样。
en: and in the end was captured alive in a cellar and hanged. A once-dominant figure met such an end—and was not Gaddafi the same?

text: 包括最近的马杜罗也是，，前两年的阿萨德，人家这就叫识时务者为俊杰，一看苗头不对，带着老婆孩子撒丫子跑路，有多大能耐就办多大事，泽连斯基也是不服气，非要比划比划，但人家后面以前有民主党撑腰，现在有欧洲撑腰，普大弟还真拿他没办法
en: Including the recent Maduro as well,, and Assad from the past couple of years—that is what 'those who understand the times are the wise' means: as soon as you sense things going wrong, take your wife and children and run off. Do only as much as your ability allows. Zelensky also would not back down and insisted on a showdown, but behind him he had the Democratic Party's backing before and now has Europe's backing, and Putin really can do nothing about him.

text: 一句话，人得有自知之明，这话听着容易，做起来可就难了
en: In a word: a person must know their own limits. That sounds easy to hear, but is hard to put into practice.

text: 已经45了。
en: Already 45.

text: 在深圳，只看资产，比大多同龄亲戚朋友好很多，但日子过得内耗、焦虑得不行。
en: In Shenzhen, looking only at assets, I am much better off than most relatives and friends my age, but day to day I live with terrible internal friction and anxiety.

text: 名下有住宅粤海两套、蛇口一套，大套的自住，小的两套出租，房租有两万多，太太收自用，其中一套还欠一百出头的贷款，三套房按现市场价大概四千多，另有商铺价值两千多，个人账上现金加基金股票共有六百多。
en: In my name I have two flats in Yuehai and one in Shekou; the large one I live in, the two smaller ones are rented out for over twenty thousand in rent, which my wife collects for her own use. One of them still owes a loan of just over one million. The three flats at current market price are worth around forty-odd million; in addition there is a shop worth over twenty million, and on my personal account cash plus funds and stocks total over six million.

text: 有个公司，夕阳行业，收入在降，但尚有老本。
en: I have a company in a sunset industry; income is falling but there is still a nest egg.

text: 父母名下也各有资产。
en: My parents each also have assets in their names.

text: 三孩，老婆全职。
en: Three children; my wife is a full-time homemaker.

text: 但我现在的状态是焦虑、内耗，经常失眠。
en: But my current state is anxiety and internal friction, and I often suffer from insomnia.

text: 公司需要亲自处理琐碎事情烦多，又知无再发展的无力感；母亲近两三年身体状况不断，需时常陪伴医院往返奔波；父亲身体还好，但对钱财太洒脱，每年在老家村族同乡之间开销太大，各种修坟盖庙、宗亲联谊捐助、借出款不断；有一弟在公司上班，本意培养分担业务，奈何性格粗心大意又无责任心，做事情多需善后，父母过于宠爱。
en: The company requires me to handle trivial matters in person, which is endlessly annoying, and I feel a sense of powerlessness knowing there is no further room to grow. My mother's health has been declining over the past two or three years and needs me to keep accompanying her on trips back and forth to the hospital. My father's health is fine, but he is far too careless with money, spending far too much each year among the village clan and fellow townsfolk back home—constantly repairing graves, building temples, donating to clan reunions, and lending money out. I have a younger brother working at the company, intended to be trained to share the business, but his careless character and lack of responsibility mean I mostly have to clean up after him, and my parents dote on him far too much.

text: 太太虽全职却是从不下厨、家务卫生全依赖阿姨，过于爱好奢侈品、热衷旅游、痴迷帮孩子各种补习和兴趣班，多有埋怨我应努力发展业务增加收入。
en: Although my wife is a full-time homemaker she never cooks, and leaves all housework and cleaning to the helper. She is overly fond of luxury goods, keen on travel, and obsessed with signing the children up for all sorts of tutoring and interest classes, and often complains that I should work harder to grow the business and increase income.

text: 老大老二都是初中，成绩中下，最近还性格反叛。
en: The eldest and second are both in junior high, with below-average grades, and recently have rebellious attitudes.

text: 别人看我好好，我却全是中年事事无力感。
en: Others see me as doing fine, but I am full of a middle-aged sense of powerlessness in everything.
